newsitem.title: CHINA: China retail sales seen up 18 percent in 1997.
newsitem.headline: China retail sales seen up 18 percent in 1997.

text.p: Chinese retail sales of consumer goods are expected to grow to about 2.9 trillion yuan in 1997, up by around 18 percent compared with this year, the Financial News said on Monday.

Retail sales would be closely linked to the state of the economy, which was expected to continue to enjoy stable growth next year, the newspaper quoted the Ministry of Internal Trade's Information Centre as saying.

It gave no details of the growth in sales expected for individual categories of retail goods, but said supply and demand of grain, oils, meat, vegatables and other major agricultural items would be roughly balanced.
Competition among manufactured goods for daily use would continue to increase, with an easing of the problem of oversupply in some goods, it said. It gave no details.
